derivedFrom: ../payment-roundtrip/source.csv (City of Chicago Payments, see its provenance.json)
selection: First 250 payments whose check_date is a full MM/DD/YYYY date, in file order. Year-only rolled-up rows are skipped because Sure needs a calendar date.
transformation: Written in Sure's transactions.csv export layout: date as YYYY-MM-DD, account_name 'Everyday Checking', amount as published (positive = money out, Sure's stored convention), name = vendor_name, empty category and tags, notes = rt-NNNN so every row has a unique key, currency USD.
